{{Top|leg}}
'''Shelas Biiks''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who stole an experimental [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. Biiks offered to sell the starship to the Republic, an offer that was accepted.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Imperial Joyride}}</ref>
